title: move cgroup check to SetupRootless
body:
Podman runs two copies, that's the main thing. Copy one starts copy two. Podman has a check, is there a login session, if it is not, warn and use cgroupfs. The problem is that check is in a place that runs before the restart. So copy one checked and warned, then copy two checked and warned again, so there are two warnings.

The fix is I moved the check to the place called SetupRootless, in a part that only runs after the restart. So now only copy two does the check and there is one warning. Nothing else changes.

I tested on WSL, before the fix runs 2 to 4 showed the warning two times, after the fix only one time.

Credit to the maintainer Luap99 who suggested this place in his review, that really helped me to go deep on this.

Fixes: #24004
